execution_gates: Existing held leases must be explicitly reconciled before overlapping work.
No new compiler/display entitlement; retain the shared allocation protocol.
New dependencies, upstream builds/services and credential changes retain exact action review.

residual_policy: After each finite behavior/rule/classifier family, enumerate the next source-backed sibling family in a new PR. These 47 units start all 18 areas but do not close the incomplete baseline inventory or all 735 grammar / 848 AST obligations.
